children: An AI market correction would affect the real economy, though the severity would depend on different scenarios, a senior IMF official said on Tuesday.

The first round of an AI market correction would not necessarily affect non-AI-related stocks, and it would feed back into the real economy through the wealth effect of AI share price reductions, said Athanasios Vamvakidis, the IMF's deputy director of monetary and capital markets.
